values: Reviewed 2026-09-09. Priority and difficulty are reviewed estimates. Difficulty: 1 easy to 5 very hard. Effort includes focused verification.
Check note survives save, lesson completion, route exit, restart and remote refresh; fix persistence or cache overwrite if reproduced.
User-authored reading/meaning notes disappear after lessons, damaging trust and losing work.
Keyboard switching, corrupt input and iPad focus
Reproduce SwiftKey character corruption first. Treat auto-switch compatibility and iPad keyboard persistence as separate remaining slices.
Corrupt input reported; related keyboard gaps
Incorrect text while typing/deleting can cause wrong grading. Existing auto-switch settings do not resolve reported third-party keyboard failures.
Slow startup and completion on poor connections
Bound startup/update and completion waits; let reviews finish locally and synchronize queued progress later.

Minutes-long startup and completion stalls obstruct the core study loop. Developer acknowledges work needed but assumes weak connectivity; existing offline storage does not establish that waiting behavior is fixed.
Lessons and reviews unavailable fully offline
Reproduce fully offline lessons/reviews with a previously synchronized account; fix cache/bootstrap readiness and offline entry.
Complete loss of the core study workflow offline, beyond the separate slow-network timeout report.
Android vocabulary lessons stall and audio overlaps
Profile current Android lesson loading and audio taps; fix remaining main-thread stall, coalescing repeated playback requests.

Multiple Android users unable to study vocabulary for 10–60 seconds with overlapping audio. Current source has deferred state updates, loading UI and audio request identity checks, so do not assume historical bug persists or that mitigations prove fixed.
Android review kanji shrink to unreadable size
Merge with C39 and reproduce Android prompt autosizing across Gboard show/hide and question changes.
Makes core question text unreadable; multiple devices/users and temporary exit/reenter workaround.
Reproduce clipped review prompts with keyboard, long vocabulary and font settings; correct layout measurement.
Unreadable prompts interfere with core reviews. Clipping is related to, but distinct from, tiny-font reports.
Test persisted mode, repeated questions and audio quiz on Android; fix empty choice panels if the issue remains.
Recent changes in #64 address eligibility and remove the older toggle; the reported blank menu is not proven resolved.
Dashboard lesson and review counts become stale
Consolidate stale dashboard counts with C24; reproduce refresh-overwrite and reconcile caches.

Multiple users saw lessons/reviews far above actual and refresh briefly showed correct count then reverted. Core progress trust issue; learned-kanji definition explains only some count differences. Same main outcome as C24.
Verify radical choices after fix; reproduce back-to-back reading/meaning with reporter settings, then fix or close the remaining interaction.
Feature delivered; latest back-to-back problem remains unconfirmed

Developer and reporter confirm multiple choice mostly works, including follow-up fixes; final developer comment says back-to-back failure could not be reproduced. Do not estimate a new multiple-choice implementation.
Finish remembered character suffix and link toggling; verify selection, cursor, Japanese input and clipboard behaviour.
Earlier link fixes merged in #78; last requests have uncommitted implementations and need verification.
Note editor usability and formatting extensions
Verify merged small-iPhone layout/keyboard fixes; preserve configurable highlights, strikethrough and rich clipboard requirements.
Bold/italic/underline and visual editing already exist. #78 addresses layout; remaining formatting additions are P3, while usability verification is P2.
Verify long review words with previous-answer card visible before reveal; reserve layout space and prevent scroll gestures revealing answers if still reproducible.
Unresolved old iPhone report; later typography fixes may affect reproduction
Prompt obstruction harms answering; reporter says scrolling works only after reveal and may accidentally reveal. Needs current reproduction, not assumed fixed by generic font work.
Vocab reviews not centered; level & SRS not visible
Show level/SRS metadata alongside visible context hints and adjust prompt alignment with external keyboards.
Current code still suppresses metadata in this combination.
Two reports demonstrate incompatible enabled settings; localized review layout problem.
iPhone lesson notes and reading hints are clipped
Reproduce long notes and reading hints in unified lessons; fix clipped content and glyphs on affected iPhones.
Reporter clarified actual truncation rather than inability to scroll. Recent editor/render changes mean first verify; no direct closure confirmation.
Fix kanji/radical overflow at larger text sizes. Scaling controls already exist; Mac audio is tracked under C32.
Partially implemented; author explicitly says added scaling is unusable in kanji/radical layouts.
Accessibility enhancement exists but breaks reading of key content at high scale.
Verify duplicate cancellation; if still reproducible, serialize daily reminder scheduling and reconcile external study when refreshed.
Old bug, partial defensive code exists

27 duplicate notifications is significant reliability friction. Current cancellation scans all scheduled lesson-reminder IDs; concurrent rescheduling and external WaniKani completion still require device validation. Distinct from C02 review-notification grouping.
Reproduce warm-cache startup and reconcile Now/current-hour counts from one consistent assignment snapshot.
Temporary duplicate counts self-correct after sync but misrepresent workload. Distinct from generic wrong count reports unless shared trigger established.
1–3 days investigation/fix; provider failure may require fallback work
Reproduce automatic and manual lyrics search on Android; separate transport/provider failures from no-results. Track Spotify connection separately unless same cause is proven.
Developer suspected temporary service outage, but later two users report all songs/manual searches failing across Android devices. Cannot close from earlier works-for-me reply.
AirPlay and screen share don’t work
Reproduce AirPlay geometry/keyboard occlusion; fix layout state recovery across session changes.
Attempted fix; later report still broken

Initial kanji disappearance changed to keyboard hiding answer input after attempted fix. Reporter provides workaround activating keyboard in another screen first. Distinct external-display trigger; do not assume same cause as Android layout.
Android delayed back navigation and image uploads
Prevent delayed repeated Back taps from exiting a review; reproduce sub-limit screenshot upload failures. Text defects are tracked separately.
The clipping and tiny-font complaints are consolidated under G54 and C38. This work item preserves the distinct double-navigation and attachment failures.
Submit context multiple-choice answers in one tap
Submit the tapped choice directly and preserve pause/next-question behaviour and duplicate-submit protection.
Small repeated-flow improvement; current choice press only selects an index before a separate submit.
Play context sentence audio after correct answers
Add after-correct playback timing and replay access without racing automatic question advancement.
Speech, speed and replay controls exist; present autoplay runs at question start and feedback stops it.
Design reversible recent-answer handling with deferred submission, then implement Anki undo and correct-answer reversal.
Protects study accuracy after accidental ratings. Requires preserving session/SRS state and respecting already-submitted WaniKani results; not a simple back button.
Refresh the existing Android export branch, verify permission/deck/field setup, and test text export on device.
Implementation exists on f/anki-export-android. Estimate is remaining text-export integration, excluding audio/images and iOS.
Add separate row selection and select-all/move/copy/remove actions inside the List tab; reuse transfer logic.
Earlier whole-list transfer exists; requested bulk-selection UI remains
This extends C20: asks to choose a subset in the current List tab rather than transfer the current membership set. Existing per-list transfer passes all selectedSubjectIds.
Close confirmed original sorting/dismiss/scroll fixes; separately verify small-screen filter modal and add list sorting to lesson/review pickers.
Original requests confirmed fixed; later requests unresolved
Requester confirms original three fixes on June 9, then asks picker parity; another user reports iPhone SE filter clipping. Current custom-list sorting and scroll restoration exist.
Preserve delivered started-state indication/filter; add select-unstarted → lesson queue action.
Partly implemented; requested lesson launch absent

Developer explicitly says starting lessons from unlock page still absent, and current page filters not-started items but shows no lesson queue/start action. Reuse existing lesson picker/session paths.
Replace earlier delivered review notifications when a newer one arrives; verify overnight/background behavior in an iOS build.
Hourly notifications accumulate and annoy users. Native scheduling/replacement behavior and background execution require more than changing display grouping.
Reproduce stroke-order animation on affected iPhone/iPad with accessibility and reduced-motion settings; inspect animation lifecycle.
Unresolved; two distinct Apple-device reports, no confirmed fix.
Breaks a study aid but ordinary reviews remain possible. More evidence is needed to distinguish never-starting from prematurely-completing animation.
Verify and restore selectable meaning/reading/example text where requested. Hint clipping is grouped under C16; the initial batch-size issue self-resolved.
Selection scope remains; batch size resolved
User confirms two-lesson batching works after first batch. Unified lesson hint clipping matches C16/C58; current sentence/translation Text is selectable, but full selectable coverage needs checking.
Reproduce duplicated reset-history bars and correct event/history deduplication or classification.

Developer initially explained gray current-level bar; reporter clarified two dark reset bars besides current level. Need actual progression/reset fixture; current reset-aware utilities alone do not prove graph fixed.
Mac context audio and vacation statistics follow-up
Verify Mac context speech. Separately identify the vacation-history/statistics symptom from the supplied example before estimating that follow-up.
Audio support unclear; statistics needs detail
Original Mac-audio question and a separate vacation-statistics complaint share one report. Neither should be silently discarded or treated as one root cause.
Save sentences from multiple sources to review lists
4–8 days for capture/list/manual review MVP; SRS separate
Implement reusable sentence capture and list storage across sources, then review selected sentences; scope scheduling separately.
Accepted; notebook and custom-SRS foundations exist, universal native sentence lists not established
Four likes and multiple corroborating comments; recurrent workflow spanning WaniKani, custom sentences, anime/news/music. Saving a sentence is a different outcome from exporting it to Anki.
Bridge native subject cards/context practice to shared notebook sentences and prepare rollout. Track handwriting separately.

Notebook foundation and web bidirectional sentence editing merged in #73; native integration and public rollout remain. The later handwriting request is a P3 extension with substantial local drafts, requiring separate device validation and completion estimate.
0.5–1.5 days for answer display; verify existing behavior first
Keep completed audio-only/reading work closed; add the latest requested kanji representation or compact answer-display preference.
Original feature and reading display delivered; kanji/customizable reveal follow-up open
Reporter thanked the developer twice, then specifically asked for kanji on revealed answers. This is a small extension, not a new listening mode.
Add a session-only autoplay override in existing review controls; restore saved preference for the next session.
Avoid toggling persistent settings each session; one commenter objects to extra screen clutter. Use existing settings/overflow space if available.
Preload or cache the chosen font and keep it stable through a question; check cold starts and downloaded fonts.
Optional fonts hydrate after initial rendering. Cosmetic and separate from tiny or clipped prompt bugs.
Reproduce overlapping badges, stabilise landing positions and verify phone/tablet layouts.
Visible animation defect outside the core study flow; no targeted fix found.
Normalize/display canonical anime titles while preserving source identifiers and punctuation.
Does not affect the learning functionality; external source metadata may require explicit canonical-title mapping.
Expose optional vocabulary kanji composition on Anki answer reveal, reusing cached components.

Useful answer detail with existing component data; less urgent than correctness/blocked study. Current paused-detail hydration explicitly excludes effectiveAnkiCardMode, so generic detailed-answer support does not settle this request.
Beginner reading aids and remaining romaji option
Finish optional romaji display if desired. On/kun speech, grouped examples and random order were added; bulk list actions remain under C12.
User confirms iOS on/kun speech works; reading-grouped examples and random ordering were answered, parts-of-speech filters exist. Romaji display remains unconfirmed.
Kana frequency and JLPT coverage refinements
2–4 days for remaining frequency-form and coverage refinements
Retain kana-versus-kanji frequency rank display; verify frequency thresholds and JLPT filters in remaining games. Preserve completed JLPT, frequency and radical features.
Mostly implemented with residual feature requests.

Author explicitly confirms JLPT lists and frequency display. Later code includes frequency-threshold custom reviews, crossword JLPT filters, and inline radical reminders. Separate kana-versus-kanji frequency display still appears absent.
Define and add projected WaniKani completion date; retain separate haptics support follow-up if still reproducible.
Feature outstanding; developer says it never existed.
A useful planning statistic, lower impact than study reliability. Haptics comment has settings guidance, not a confirmed defect.
Separate custom-first order and speech speed from saved sentence selection, kana/furigana, bilingual alignment and constrained AI generation.
Six requests including the comment. Small ordering/audio improvements merit P2; alignment and AI vocabulary restrictions need separate scoping.
Start with hidden-English gaps and audio-to-Japanese modes; scope Japanese answer policy, dictionary, picture quizzes and localisation separately.
Full request spans seven features. Existing hidden-translation and audio foundations help, but dictionary/content and localisation remain major work.
Define mixed-session scheduling and introduce a controlled lesson/review interleaving option.
Changes the central session model and progress semantics for an optional workflow.
1–3 days feasibility/prototype, implementation depends on available voices
Investigate native Japanese voice selection only if still needed with current cloud TTS; communicate supported voice choices.
Siri voice request unresolved; enhanced-voice workaround confirmed

Unlike broad C51 quality feedback, this explicitly requests selecting Siri Japanese voices. Current native fallback passes language/rate without a voice identifier; cloud voice restoration does not fulfill native Siri selection.
Add a review-count complication to the Watch companion. Lockscreen widget is delivered; repeated handwriting loading is tracked under C65.

Requester confirmed lockscreen widget May 19 and supplied a precise repeated-session freehand repro May 31. Watch scaffold/audit explicitly lacks complication support; full Watch reviews C67 is separate scope.
Continue existing Watch branch only after core reliability fixes; reconcile submission/session/cache hazards and validate paired release.
Substantial unmerged branch; release checks remain

Current refined Watch branch integrated main and physical installs were attempted; documented blockers remain around stale replies, double count, phone cache/recovery, radicals and logout. No real review submissions verified. C56 complication is a separate smaller feature, not satisfied by review app.
2–4 weeks for public-quality OCR and requested format coverage
Treat as unreleased prototype: decide whether basic reading can ship separately from OCR quality, and specify CBR support.
Existing hidden reader prototype; not fulfilled publicly.
Developer says on-device OCR fails roughly half the time; code accepts CBZ/images but does not show CBR support. Consider product scope before committing.

External keyboard answers lose final characters
Verify rapid typing and Enter on an external keyboard in a build containing PR #64; reopen implementation only if characters still disappear.
Likely fixed in #64; hardware check needed
False wrong answers are serious, but current code specifically captures native submission text and resets before new input.
Verify Android lesson note keyboard remains stable on Pixel with current plain/rich editor; keep separate from note durability.
Verify recent editor fixes on Pixel
Keyboard opening/closing rapidly prevents note entry. Recent code targets this area but no report confirmation.
Repeated handwriting sessions get stuck loading
½–1 day repeated-session verification; 1–3 days fix if reproduced
Verify exact repeat-session freehand repro using C56 comments; close confirmed redraw/layout requests.
Partial fixes; current loader protections need verification

User confirmed redraw and compact results implemented but loading bug persisted then. Current question key includes session/index/subject/character and quiz has rejected/pending load handling, making recheck preferable to assuming original failure still present.
Verify personal Spotify client-ID onboarding and authentication, then resolve old shared-client report.

Thread identified shared application authorization restrictions, and users accepted personal-client setup. Current service persists a personal ID and binds tokens to it, with auth tests. No fresh external policy verification performed.
½–1 day verification; 1–2 days if Mac focus bug persists
Close confirmed iPad arrow navigation; check Mac iPad-app second lesson batch focus before marking entire report resolved.
iPad confirmed fixed; Mac followup unconfirmed
Current focus effect depends on batch index, active tab and screen focus, which addresses reported lifecycle trigger in principle. Need actual Mac multi-batch verification.
Context cloze replaces the wrong sentence segment
Reproduce 思う with 日本の人口について、どう思いますか？ and verify the prefix survives while the correct verb segment is blanked/revealed. Earlier layout and tilde requests were delivered.
Malformed historical cloze; verify current build
The attached reveal screenshot shows 思う、どう思いますか？ while subject details show the full sentence. This identifies a malformed cloze rather than an unexplained details mismatch.
½–1 day verification; 1–3 days if native voice selection remains desired
Check current Azure voices/fallback behavior; split native Siri selection into C57 if still wanted.
Historical provider fallback changed; quality not verified

May report describes old all-native fallback. Current Azure service supports named cloud voices, rotating keys and native fallback; latest comment only suggests Bunpro voice quality, not proof current service still broken.
Check the installed wide widget with Critical mode; close if the existing medium layout meets the request, otherwise clarify desired multi-item layout.
Likely implemented; exact wide-widget expectation uncertain
Code already selects Critical labels in medium widgets and includes count plus top critical item. Request does not specify whether it expects several characters at once.
Transfering subjects from one list to another
Verify current copy/move transfer and list filtering satisfy baseline, then close; retain C12 subset/bulk UI separately.
Baseline implemented; later same reporter acknowledges delivery in C12
Transfer modal supports copy and move; C12 explicitly thanks the already-incorporated feature. C12 is an extension, not a duplicate requiring the original feature twice.
Close implemented quick-review request; verify remembered filter behavior covers follow-up before closing that follow-up.
Quick review delivered; verify remembered filters
List shortcut exists and custom-review configuration persists. Per-list memory versus global memory was not specified, so do not invent a per-list feature.
Ascending order and lowest level first working together
Verify lowest-level-first + interleave configuration, then close if matching requested ordering.
Developer says setting added. Current lesson ordering explicitly preserves level groups during interleaving.
Keeping Item Type Order sorting while on Most Overdue First review
Verify type ordering with Most Overdue First, then close if satisfied.
Current comparator applies enabled item type order before review-order comparator (critical-item priority can still override by design). This matches radicals first then overdue within type.
Verify crossword/random-test history avoidance and keyboard preferences; close fulfilled slices, retaining any current reproduction.

Crossword penalty and random-test recent history both now exist. User confirmed crossword keyboard change in August; initial iPad keyboard report overlaps C44 but this thread bundles distinct repeat avoidance.
Obtain one concrete screen/example and desired Japanese/furigana/audio output before scheduling.
Needs scope clarification; developer question unanswered
The request does not identify what should be translated or where audio/furigana belongs. Do not assume it duplicates Japanese-to-Japanese #80.
No implementation; close the resolved report
Close as delivered, retaining its source history.
The lesson search button was merged and the reporter says Thank you, that is great.
Remove from actionable backlog; retain as community announcement.
Announcement, not a bug or feature request
Developer announces existing web beta; comments are congratulations only.
Close as fixed; keep a regression example for above-level subjects explicitly selected in a list.
Developer removed the level limitation and reporter confirmed noticing the fix.
Bookmark indicator and lesson frequency filter
No work for completed baseline; route kana-frequency follow-up to existing frequency request
Close delivered baseline. The later kana-versus-kanji frequency request is retained with C28.

Developer says Done and reporter confirms immediately noticing the filled bookmark indicator. Last comment explicitly references another ticket about kana frequency; do not reopen baseline as a broad feature bundle.
How to adjust input font size?
Close as implemented; point to Review input text size setting.
Implemented; developer confirmation and current setting.
The requested independent review-input font scaling already exists.
Close implemented crossword result display/audio request after routine release check.
Implemented and reporter confirmed; subsequent kana-audio defect also addressed.
Author calls it perfect/working; developer later confirms fix for kana-only audio.
Requested apprentice/guru lesson thresholds exist and are acknowledged.
No implementation; optional current service smoke check
Archive historical developer service-status announcement; retain current voice requests as C51/C57.
Historical announcement superseded by fallback/provider work

Developer announced replacement fallback and users confirmed availability. Current Azure speech implementation has native fallback; this is not an independently actionable open bug without fresh evidence.
